# Chaos Designer Skill

> **Category:** Generic Skills

## Overview

Design chaos engineering experiments with defined blast radius, steady state hypotheses, abort conditions, and observability integration.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [chaos-designer-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
chaos-designer-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@chaos-designer` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Analyze complex systems and decompose into manageable components
- Design solutions following established patterns and conventions
- Generate structured artifacts with consistent formatting and quality
- Validate outputs against acceptance criteria and quality gates

## Industry Standards Applied

- **ITIL v4**: IT service management: incident, problem, change management
- **SRE Principles (Google)**: SLO/SLI, error budgets, toil reduction, blameless postmortems
- **ISO 20000**: IT service management system requirements
